user.title: Choose the printer
user.description: Select the Bambu Lab printer (ha-bambulab) to track.

bambu.title: Printer entities
bambu.description: {found} entities were detected for {printer}. Check or correct them.

data_description.job_name_entity: Used to tell two prints apart and to match HaspelSync.
data_description.print_weight_entity: Fallback when HaspelSync has no data.

data_description.energy_entity: Recommended: a cumulative meter is exact, even across restarts.
data_description.price_entity: Any entity in EUR/kWh, c€/kWh or EUR/MWh. It may change during a print.
data_description.integration_method: Only used when no energy meter is available.

filament.title: Filament (optional)
filament.description: Leave empty to track electricity only. HaspelSync provides the real consumption, Spoolman the spool prices. Neither is ever modified.

data.filament_fallback: When no real consumption is available

data_description.spoolman_url: e.g. http://192.168.1.10:7912 — read only, never modified.
